description: Retrieve a secret from 1Password using either a secret reference (op://vault/item/field) or vault ID + item ID. Supports field selection and optional value reveal (defaults to metadata-only). Revealing a secret puts it in the model context/transcript — to USE a secret in a command or API call, prefer op_run with op:// references instead.

field.description: Field id or title to read. Defaults to 'password'.

itemId.description: Item ID for item lookup (required if secretReference is not provided).

reveal.description: If true, include the secret value in plaintext in the response — this puts the secret in the model context/transcript. Defaults to false; prefer op_run to use a secret without revealing it.

secretReference.description: Secret reference in op://vault/item/field format. If provided, vaultId and itemId are ignored.

vaultId.description: Vault ID for item lookup (required if secretReference is not provided).

name: password_read
